sentences.chinese: 现在是晚上九点四十分，方小英刚刚打开 QQ 一小会儿，就有一个她不认识的男人来叫她。

sentences.chinese: 那个人有一会儿没有说话。
sentences.english: That person remained silent for a while.

sentences.chinese: “我们认识吗？

sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying asked again.

sentences.english: The person waited for a little while, then slowly said, “Can I dance with you?”

sentences.chinese: 方小英一下子高兴起来。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying became very happy.

sentences.chinese: “打开视频[45]，让我看看你。
sentences.english: “Play the video[45] and let me see you.”

sentences.chinese: 方小英马上打开了视频，高亮一定看见她了，可是，高亮不让她看见他自己。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying immediately opened the video; Gao Liang must have seen her, but Gao Liang prevented her from seeing it himself.

sentences.chinese: 这个时候，高亮相信这真的是方小英了。
sentences.english: At this moment, Gao Liang believes it is really Fang Xiaoying.

sentences.chinese: “小英，我要再一次请你帮我，行吗？
sentences.english: “Xiaoying, I want to ask you to help me once more, is that okay?”

sentences.chinese: ”方小英很高兴地说， “我相信你，我也…
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying said happily, “I trust you, and I also…”

sentences.english: However, we can’t talk much here.

sentences.english: I would like you to visit my mother tomorrow. Please tell her that I can’t go home or write to her, but I haven’t done anything bad to her.

sentences.chinese: 她的身体不好，请她每天好好[46]吃药，好好地等着我回来…
sentences.english: She isn’t feeling well; please make sure she takes her medicine daily and waits for me to return…

sentences.chinese: 还有，今天的事，一定不要告诉别人。
sentences.english: Also, don’t tell anyone about what happened today.

sentences.chinese: 在拿钱的人没有找出来前，谁都不要相信[47]！
sentences.english: No one should be trusted until the person who took the money returns it[47]!

sentences.chinese: 第二天中午，李行长已经吃完饭，很舒服地坐在那儿看书。
sentences.english: At noon the next day, President Li had finished eating and was sitting comfortably reading a book.

sentences.chinese: 方小英对她说：“我有一点儿事，想出去一会儿。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying said to her, "I have something to do and need to go out for a while."

sentences.chinese: 李行长说：“等一等。
sentences.english: President Li said, “Wait a moment.”

sentences.chinese: 小英啊，你看，你在我家工作得不错。
sentences.english: Xiao Ying, look, you’re doing well at my house.

sentences.chinese: 我觉得一个月给你800块钱有点儿少，我想一个月多给你200块钱。
sentences.english: I think 800 yuan a month is a little too little; I would like to give you 200 yuan more per month.

sentences.chinese: 方小英高兴地说：“这太好了，谢谢您！
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying said happily, “That’s great! Thank you!”

sentences.chinese: “小英啊，我还是要问问你，你知道高亮现在在哪儿吗？
sentences.english: “Xiao Ying, I still need to ask you—do you know where Gao Liang is now?”

sentences.chinese: 方小英刚想告诉她昨天晚上他们在网上见面的事，但是她很快想到了高亮的话，就对李行长说：“不，我不知道他在哪里。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying was about to tell her about their meeting online last night, but soon remembered Gao Liang’s words, and said to President Li, “No, I don’t know where he is.”

sentences.chinese: “什么时候知道了，一定要马上告诉我，好吗？
sentences.english: “When you know it, please tell me right away, okay?”

sentences.chinese: 方小英回到自己住的地方，换上一件漂亮的新衣服，她要去看高亮的妈妈。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying returned to her place and put on a beautiful new dress. She wanted to visit Gao Liang's mother.

sentences.chinese: 高亮的家很远，从李行长家去那里要换两次公共汽车。
sentences.english: Gao Liang’s home is far away; it takes two bus trips from President Li’s house.

sentences.chinese: 方小英走着走着，觉得好像什么地方有点儿不对，因为有个穿红[48]衣服的男人老在后边[49]跟着[50]她，在那个穿红衣服的男人后边，好像还跟着一个长得很高的男人…
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying walked, but felt something was off. A man wearing red[48] clothes kept following[49] her from behind[50]. Behind that man in red, there seemed to be another tall man too…

sentences.chinese: 方小英看过一些电影和电视，知道一些这样的事，她什么都没想，马上跑上了最近的公共汽车。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying has watched some movies and TV shows and knows about such things. Without thinking anything, she immediately got on the nearest bus.

sentences.chinese: 公共汽车开走的时候，方小英看见那个穿红衣服的男人和那个长得很高的男人都没有上来，方小英很高兴。
sentences.english: When the bus drove away, Fang Xiaoying saw that neither the man in red clothes nor the very tall man got on. Fang Xiaoying was very happy.

sentences.chinese: 方小英换了两次公共汽车，又走了一会儿，来到高亮家门前。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying took two different buses, and after a while, she arrived in front of Gao Liang’s house.

sentences.chinese: 这时候她往后边看了看，啊，坏了，那个穿红衣服的男人就在不远的地方看着她！
sentences.english: At that moment, she looked back. Ah, trouble—the man in red clothes was watching her not far away!

sentences.chinese: 再远一点儿，那个长得很高的男人，还是跟在那个穿红衣服的男人后边…
sentences.english: A little further away, that tall man is still following behind the man in red clothes...

sentences.chinese: 方小英知道，现在想走已经太晚了，他们都已经知道她是去高亮的家…
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying knows that it’s too late to leave now; they have already learned that she is going to Gao Liang’s house…

sentences.chinese: 高亮的爸爸不在家，高亮的妈妈给方小英打开了门，很客气地问：“小姐，您找谁？
sentences.english: Gao Liang’s father is not at home, so Gao Liang’s mother opened the door for Fang Xiaoying and politely asked, “Miss, who are you looking for?”

sentences.chinese: 高亮的妈妈是大学老师，因为孩子出了事，她好像很不高兴，但是她说话的时候还是非常客气。
sentences.english: The child’s mother is a university teacher. She seems unhappy due to what happened to her child, but she remains very polite when speaking.

sentences.chinese: “请问，这是高亮的家吗？
sentences.english: “Excuse me, is this Gao Liang’s house?”

sentences.chinese: 我是高亮的朋友，我来告诉您一些高亮的事。
sentences.english: I’m a friend of Gao Liang, and I’ll tell you some things about him.

sentences.chinese: 高亮的妈妈马上高兴起来，她看了看长得非常清纯的方小英说：“请进请进！
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying’s mother immediately became happy. She looked at her very pure-looking daughter and said, “Please come in, please!”

sentences.chinese: 方小英走了进去。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying walked in.

sentences.chinese: 没想到，在高亮家里她看见了一个和她常常见面的人。
sentences.english: Unexpectedly, at Gao Liang’s house, she saw a person she often meets.

sentences.chinese: “这是银行信贷部副[51]经理刘一民。
sentences.english: “This is Liu Yimin, the deputy manager of the banking credit department[51].”

sentences.chinese: ”高亮的妈妈不知道方小英认识刘一民，她给方小英介绍说：“一民和高亮两个人在大学的时候是同学也是好朋友，看，那是他们学生时候在教室里学习的照片，是不是像哥哥和弟弟一样？
sentences.english: “Gao Liang’s mother didn’t know that Fang Xiaoying knew Liu Yimin. She introduced them to each other by saying, “Yimin and Gao Liang were classmates and good friends during their university years. Look, this is a photo of them studying in the classroom during their time at university. Do they look like an older brother and younger brother?”

sentences.chinese: 方小英看见，照片上，刘一民和高亮坐得很近，真的像哥哥和弟弟一样。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying saw in the photo that Liu Yimin and Gao Liang were sitting very close together, really like an older brother and a younger brother.

sentences.chinese: “这几年，他们又在银行一起工作，是非常好的朋友。
sentences.english: “In recent years, they have worked together at the bank and are very good friends.”

sentences.chinese: 今天是我的生日，前几天高亮出了事，很多人都不来了，但是一民还是像前几年一样来看我，还送给我生日礼物。
sentences.english: Today is my birthday. A few days ago, there were some issues, and many people didn’t come, but Yi Min still visited me like in previous years and gave me a birthday gift.

sentences.chinese: 在这样的时候真的能看出来[52]，谁是最好的朋友！
sentences.english: At times like these, it’s really easy to see who is the best friend! [52]

sentences.chinese: 这时候，方小英也已经看见，房子里有一些很漂亮的生日礼物。
sentences.english: At this time, Fang Xiaoying also saw some beautiful birthday gifts in the house.

sentences.chinese: “刘一民真不错！
sentences.english: “Liu Yimin is really great!”

sentences.chinese: 方小英跟刘一民见过很多次面，今年，刘一民常常去李行长家。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying has met Liu Yimin many times. This year, Liu Yimin often goes to President Li’s house.

sentences.chinese: 他一来，李行长就会马上叫方小英出去买东西，有的时候还让她买很多东西，所以，方小英常常看得见刘一民什么时候来，看不见刘一民什么时候走。
sentences.english: As soon as he arrives, President Li immediately asks Fang Xiaoying to go buy things, and sometimes she is asked to buy a lot of items. Therefore, Fang Xiaoying can often see when Liu Yimin comes, but not when he leaves.

sentences.chinese: 方小英知道，李行长要和刘一民说工作上的事，银行的工作都是大事，不能让自己听见。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying knew that President Li wanted to discuss work matters with Liu Yimin. Bank affairs are important, and she couldn’t let herself hear them.

sentences.chinese: “都在银行工作，但是，在参加party那一天以前，高亮怎么一次都没有去过李行长家呢？
sentences.english: “They all work in banks, but how could Gaoliang never visit President Li’s house before the party?

sentences.chinese: 她不知道这是为什么。
sentences.english: She doesn’t know why.

sentences.chinese: “小英，你是怎么知道高亮家的？
sentences.english: “Xiaoying, how did you know about Gao Liang’s family?”

sentences.chinese: 你这几天是不是见过高亮？
sentences.english: Have you seen Gao Liang these days?

sentences.chinese: ”刘一民因为跟方小英认识，所以一点也不客气，很快地问。
sentences.english: “Liu Yimin was friendly because he knew Fang Xiaoying, so he asked quickly without any hesitation.”

sentences.chinese: 方小英很想告诉他自己和高亮在网上见过面，但是方小英想到高亮对她说过，现在谁都不要相信，所以方小英就说：“没有。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying really wanted to tell herself that she and Gao Liang had met online, but she remembered Gao Liang saying that no one should be trusted now. So Fang Xiaoying said, “No.”

sentences.chinese: 我这几天没见过高亮，我也不知道高亮在哪里。
sentences.english: I haven’t seen Gao Liang these days, and I don’t know where he is.

sentences.chinese: “你刚才不是说，要告诉我高亮的事吗？
sentences.english: “Didn’t you just say you wanted to tell me about Gao Liang?”

sentences.chinese: ”听见方小英这样说，高亮的妈妈很快地问。
sentences.english: “Hearing Fang Xiaoying say this, Gao Liang’s mother asked quickly.”

sentences.chinese: “啊，对不起，我没有高亮的事可以告诉您。
sentences.english: “Ah, I’m sorry, but I don’t have anything to highlight for you.”

sentences.chinese: 我能告诉您的是，高亮是个好人，他一定不会拿银行的钱，请相信您的孩子，他一定会回来看您！
sentences.english: I can tell you that Gao Liang is a good person; he definitely won’t use bank money. Please trust your child—he will surely come back to see you!

sentences.chinese: 高亮的妈妈看着方小英，好像懂她的意思，又好像不懂她的意思。
sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying’s mother looked at her, as if she understood what she meant, yet also seemed to not understand.

sentences.chinese: 这天晚上，高亮穿着一件不知道从哪儿找来的很长的衣服，很快地来到一家小网吧[53]，他看了看前边和后边，觉得没有别人看见他，就走了进去。
sentences.english: That night, Gao Liang wore a long coat he didn’t know where he got it from, and quickly went to a small internet cafe[53]. He checked around front and back to make sure no one was watching him, then entered the room.

sentences.english: “Seeing that Fang Xiaoying was already online, Gao Liang said something to her.”

sentences.chinese: “我在你妈妈生日那天中午见到她了！
sentences.english: “I met her at noon on your mother’s birthday!”

sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying said nothing polite and immediately told Gao Liang.

sentences.chinese: “你怎么知道那天是我妈妈的生日？
sentences.english: “How do you know that was my mother’s birthday?

sentences.english: “Your good friend also visited your mother that day, and gave her a expensive birthday gift!”

sentences.chinese: ”高亮很快地问。
sentences.english: “Gao Liang asked quickly.”

sentences.chinese: 看见这个名字，高亮一下子不说话了。
sentences.english: Seeing this name, he stopped talking instantly.

sentences.english: He quickly thought, yes, how could I forget? Only Liu Yimin knows my birthday, as well as my mother’s birthday!

sentences.chinese: 我的电脑密码[54]就是我和妈妈的生日啊，破译[55]我的电脑密码，进我的电脑系统，用我的名字拿走银行钱的人会不会是他？
sentences.english: My computer password[54] is just my and my mother’s birthdays. Can someone break into my computer system, use my name to withdraw bank money, be him?

sentences.chinese: “你怎么不说话？
sentences.english: “Why don’t you speak?”

sentences.english: Fang Xiaoying waited by the computer for a while and asked.

sentences.english: “Ah, let’s talk about it next time.”

sentences.english: “Gao Liang went online immediately and quickly left the internet cafe.”

sentences.english: During university, I liked computer classes most, followed by English classes.

sentences.chinese: 不在教室上课的时候，他就去图书馆复习电脑和英文，考试的时候，电脑和英文他都考第一，所以，老师非常喜欢他。
sentences.english: When not in class, he goes to the library to review computer and English skills. During exams, he always gets first place in both computer and English, so the teacher really likes him.

sentences.chinese: 他还喜欢游泳和旅行，和同学、朋友一起游泳，他常常也是第一。
sentences.english: He also loves swimming and traveling. He swims with classmates and friends, and often finishes first.

sentences.chinese: 他也常常和同学、朋友一起去很远的地方玩儿，玩儿的时候他们不坐汽车，大家高兴地唱着歌[56]走，常常走很长时间。
sentences.english: He often goes to faraway places with classmates and friends. When they go there, they don’t take a car; instead, they sing songs happily and walk for a long time.

sentences.chinese: 所以高亮的身体很好。
sentences.english: So Gao Liang’s body is very good.

sentences.english: Late that night, Gao Liang went to a bank that operates only at hours. He quickly entered the password on the ATM[57], and the money appeared.

sentences.chinese: 拿着钱，高亮又高兴，又不太高兴。
sentences.english: With the money in hand, Gao Liang is both happy and a little unhappy.

sentences.chinese: 高兴的是，警察没有冻结[58]他的钱，他可以用这些钱买一个又小又好的电脑，他打算用这个电脑进银行系统，找出那个拿走钱的人。
sentences.english: It’s good that the police didn’t freeze his money [58], and he can use it to buy a small but good computer. He plans to use this computer to access the bank system and find out who took the money.

sentences.chinese: 他相信，自己可以用电脑破译那个人的密码，找到他拿钱的证据。
sentences.english: He believes he can use a computer to decode that person’s password and find evidence of how they obtained the money.

sentences.chinese: 他不相信，一个人拿走一千万块钱会不留下[59]一点儿证据。
sentences.english: He doesn’t believe that someone could take ten million yuan without leaving any evidence.

sentences.chinese: 但是，高亮也知道，他这样做，警察就会更[60]快地找到他。
sentences.english: However, Gao Liang also knew that by doing this, the police would find him much[60] faster.

sentences.english: At this point, Gao Liang quickly looked back. Upon seeing it, he felt worried—this was a large park, and due to the late hour, there were very few people.

sentences.english: In a not-so-far distance, there’s a man in red clothes who seems to be following him. He watched several times; it looks like there’s another very tall man behind the red-clothed man…

sentences.chinese: 是警察还是给自己做“局”的人？

sentences.english: Gao Liang knows he didn’t do anything bad, and he isn’t afraid of the police. But right now, he can’t let the police catch him. He must open that “office” and then go see the police again.

sentences.english: Gao Liang knows that without evidence of others receiving money or conducting schemes, anything said to the police is useless.

sentences.english: If the person following him is someone who’s planning a scheme, it would be even worse. They will catch themselves and surely kill themselves![61]

sentences.chinese: 这样想着，高亮就很快地跑起来，跑了很远很远，觉得很累，他往后边看了好几次，都没有看见那个穿红衣服的人和长得很高的人。
sentences.english: With that thought, Gao Liang ran quickly, covering a long distance. He felt very tired and looked back several times, but he couldn’t see the person in red clothes or the tall person.

sentences.english: I must find her…

sentences.chinese: 那个女孩太漂亮了，戴伟、杰夫和秋田看到了她的照片，都要去找她！
sentences.english: That girl is too beautiful. Dai Wei, Jeff, and Akita saw her photo, and they all want to meet her!

sentences.chinese: 照片是老师死前给他们的，可是照片上的中国女孩在哪儿？
sentences.english: The photos were given to them by the teacher before his death, but where is the Chinese girl in the photos?

sentences.chinese: 他们都不知道。
sentences.english: They don’t know anything.

sentences.chinese: 最后，他们到中国是怎么找到那个女孩的？
sentences.english: Finally, how did they find that girl in China?

sentences.chinese: 女孩又和他们说了什么？
sentences.english: What did the girl say to them again?

sentences.chinese: 两个想上天的孩子
sentences.english: Two children who want to reach heaven

sentences.chinese: “叔叔，在哪里买飞机票？
sentences.english: “Uncle, where can I buy airplane tickets?”

sentences.chinese: “小朋友，你们为什么来买飞机票？
sentences.english: “Kids, why did you come to buy plane tickets?”

sentences.chinese: 要去旅行吗？
sentences.english: Are you going on a trip?

sentences.chinese: ”“我们要到天上去。
sentences.english: “We want to go to heaven.”

sentences.chinese: 这两个要买飞机票的孩子，一个7岁，一个8岁。
sentences.english: The two children who need to buy plane tickets are 7 years old and 8 years old.

sentences.chinese: 没有人知道，他们为什么想上天？
sentences.english: No one knows why they want to go into space.

sentences.chinese: 这两个孩子也不知道，在他们出来以后，有人给他们的家里打电话，让他们的爸爸妈妈拿钱去换他们呢…
sentences.english: The two children didn’t know either. After they came out, someone called their family and asked their parents to bring money to exchange for them.

sentences.chinese: 向左和向右是两个男孩子的名字，爸爸妈妈也不知道向左是哥哥还是向右是哥哥，因为他们连在一起，是一起出生的连体人。
sentences.english: Left and right are the names of two boys. Mom and Dad don’t know whether left is the older brother or right is the older brother, because they were born together as a conjoined twin.

sentences.chinese: 他们每天都一起吃，一起住，一起玩。
sentences.english: They eat, live, and play together every day.

sentences.chinese: 他们常常都很快乐。
sentences.english: They are often very happy.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，弟弟病了，哥哥帮他吃药，弟弟的病就好了。
sentences.english: Sometimes, when the younger brother is sick, the older brother helps him take medicine, and his illness goes away.

sentences.chinese: 但是，学校上课的时候，他们在一起就不方便了…
sentences.english: However, it’s inconvenient for them to be together during class hours…

sentences.chinese: 你最喜欢谁？
sentences.english: Who is your favorite?

sentences.chinese: ———中关村故事之一
sentences.english: ———One of the Zhongguancun Stories

sentences.chinese: 谢红去了外国，她是方新真爱的人，可是方新不想去外国，因为他要在中关村做他喜欢的工作。
sentences.english: Xie Hong went abroad; she is Fang Xin’s true love. However, Fang Xin doesn’t want to go abroad because he wants to work in Zhongguancun, where he enjoys it.

sentences.chinese: 小月每天来看方新，她是真爱方新、也能帮方新的人，可是方新还是想着谢红。
sentences.english: Xiao Yue visits Fang Xin every day. She truly loves Fang Xin and is someone who can help him, but still, Fang Xin thinks of Xie Hong.

sentences.chinese: 方新真不知道应该怎么办…
sentences.english: Fang Xin really doesn’t know what to do…

sentences.chinese: [47] 谁都不要相信 don’t trust anyone
sentences.english: [47] Don’t trust anyone; none of them can be believed.
